description: This file defines the ArnParser class, which provides functionality to parse ARN strings specific to AWS services, returning appropriate ARN objects based on the input string.

classes.name: ArnParser
classes.description: A utility class for parsing AWS ARN strings into specific ARN objects based on their components.

methods.name: isArn
methods.description: Checks if a given string is a valid ARN by verifying it starts with 'arn:'.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an ARN string and returns a specific ARN object based on the resource and service components.

methods.name: explodeResourceComponent
methods.description: Splits a resource string into components based on '/' or ':' delimiters.
